output.brief: The crash gap is driven by build 7.4.0, not by the Tiled Canvas flag. I collected one item, X14 (crash rates by build, flag state and device memory tier). Among 7.4.0 users, flag-on and flag-off holdout users crash at nearly the same rate (2.10% vs 1.98%; the interval includes zero). The gap already existed on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp, and 7.3.2 stayed flat. Flagged users have the same device mix and usage as the holdout, so neither explains it. Turning the flag off would not fix the crashes, and shipping 7.4.0 to everyone would spread them. Next: hold the 7.4.0 rollout at its current level and have engineers find what changed in 7.4.0 (the image library upgrade or the new crash SDK are the leading suspects, not yet tested). Keep the incident open. Confidence is moderate: I did not check the crash clusters by build (X3) or the SDK details, so which 7.4.0 change is responsible is still unconfirmed.
